doc.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020

title: Keeping his hair
summary: Bergeron jokes that chemo did not take his hair.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: And the other positive thing I just wanted to say, is I got to keep my hair. You know the chemo didn’t take my hair. The radiation took it in the back but it grew back. Not that I care but you know I’ve always had good hair and I’m 62 with no gray hair you know, and so there’s not a lot of people that get to say that, so I’m always proud of my hair. As a matter of fact it looks like I dye my hair and I do not dye it.
All right. We have it on record now.

Yeah. And the people go, “Is that a rug?” I go no, this is my hair. So you know I got to keep my hair too so that’s a big plus. I was ready to shave my head to be honest with you, because I just figured I’d be losing my hair, which would be okay too, I’d just wear some hats, you know I’d embrace my baldness.
